Common frustrations, solved.

AI-driven investor research that surfaces the right people, at the right time, through the right paths.

Slide 1 of 1

Wasted first calls

Landing that crucial intro call with a lead investor, only to discover they're not actively leading rounds.

Warm intro hunts

Spending hours digging through networks just to find a mutual connection — then learning that they don't really know the investor.

Misaligned sweet spots

Jumping on an investor call only to find their focus stage is completely different from where your business currently stands.

The patchwork investor list

Cobbling together a list of relevant investors from scattered news articles, generic databases, and endless Google searches.

Inactive investors taking calls

Waiting for a response after a promising call, then discovering that the investor has been inactive for months.
